Wij zetten complexe zorgdata om in heldere inzichten waarmee zorgorganisaties grip krijgen op kosten, betere behandelresultaten realiseren en sturen op waardegedreven zorg. Onze oplossingen worden dagelijks gebruikt door meer dan 80 zorginstellingen, zowel publiek als privaat, en maken het verschil in de gezondheidszorg van morgen. Jouw impact en verantwoordelijkheden Je verhoogt de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening door het valideren van financiële en zorginhoudelijke data. Je communiceert met klanten over hun data-aanlevering en de oplevering van LOGEX modellen. Je ontwikkelt je in de breedte en biedt ondersteuning aan meerdere teams en klanten als er vragen liggen met betrekking tot de kwaliteit van data. Je signaleert en realiseert kansen om interne operationele processen te verbeteren. Je draagt bij aan automatisering van onze operationele processen, mogelijk door inzet van AI. Team Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes. Jouw profiel Relevante werkervaring: Je hebt 0–2 jaar werkervaring en affiniteit met de financiële sector en/of de gezondheidszorg. Een HBO- of WO-opleiding afgerond, bij voorkeur met een focus op gezondheid, data of economie. Data-affiniteit: Je hebt interesse in data. Je werkt nauwkeurig, signaleert trends en spoort fouten of afwijkingen op. Communicatie: Je kunt effectief communiceren met diverse teamleden

About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

As a Solution Architect in the Field Engineering team, you will span both technical pre‑sales and post‑sales, serving as a trusted advisor to our enterprise customers throughout their lifecycle. In pre‑sales, you will qualify technical fit, design future‑state architectures, run evaluations, and demonstrate how Vercel unlocks measurable business outcomes. Post-sales, you will act as a technical quarterback, helping customers successfully adopt and standardize on Vercel by aligning the right resources at the right time. You will guide architecture and implementation decisions, identify when to engage Professional Services or Developer Success, and work across Product and Engineering to unblock customers and drive long-term success for critical AI and Web workloads.

If you’re based within commuting distance of our London or Berlin office, the role includes in-office anchor days.

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. listings.title: Internship in Architecture - France | March 2027
listings.description: Des opportunités de stage chez MVRDV Paris ! MVRDV a été fondé en 1993 par Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs et Nathalie de Vries à Rotterdam, aux Pays-Bas. Nous relevons les défis urbains et architecturaux actuels en adoptant une approche collaborative dès le début du processus de conception. Nous collaborons avec les clients, les parties prenantes et des experts de divers domaines pour créer des projets audacieux et innovants qui contribuent à améliorer nos villes et nos paysages. Notre siège est à Rotterdam, mais nous avons aussi des bureaux à Paris, Shanghai et Berlin. L’équipe de Paris se concentre sur des projets passionnants en France. Par exemple, dans le passé, nous avons travaillé sur la transformation d’un bâtiment au programme mixte au cœur de Paris, des masterplans à grande échelle à Bordeaux et Caen, le centre commercial de la Part-Dieu à Lyon, et bien d'autres encore. Nous recherchons actuellement des étudiants ambitieux pour rejoindre notre équipe parisienne en tant que stagiaires. Important : vous devez être inscrit·e dans un programme universitaire éligible entre le 1er mars 2027 et le 31 août 2027 pour que votre candidature puisse être prise en compte. 🚀 CONTEXTE & ENJEUX STRATÉGIQUES

Au sein de Decathlon Digital, l'équipe People Data engage une initiative majeure : transformer l'expérience de nos 100 000 collaborateurs par l'intégration de l'IA Générative et Agentique.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to work on the runtime systems of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

listings.title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer - Fuel Cell Systems
listings.description: About EH Group Engineering EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking a Functional Safety Engineer to embed safety into our fuel cell systems, leading hazard analysis and safety engineering across hardware, software and controls to ensure our products are safe, compliant and certifiable. This role requires full-time, on-site presence at our Nyon, Switzerland office. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be prepared to relocate. Key Responsibilities: • Own the functional safety lifecycle for fuel cell systems from concept to release • Lead hazard and risk analyses (HARA, HAZOP, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA) and define safety goals • Derive safety requirements and concepts and allocate them across hardware, software and controls • Define/verify safety mechanisms, diagnostics and safe states with the controls and embedded teams • Perform safety analyses and calculations (SIL/PL/ASIL determination, metrics, PFH/PFD) • Compile safety cases, safety plans and supporting documentation for certification • Interface with notified bodies, certification authorities and customers on safety topics • Promote a strong safety culture and coach teams on functional safety practices Skills and Experience Required: • BSc/MSc in electrical, electronic, mechatronic, control or safety engineering is mandatory • Minimum 3-5 years of functional safety experience in industrial, energy or hydrogen systems • Working knowledge of safety standards (ex. IEC 61508, ISO 13849, ISO 26262 and/or IEC 62061)

listings.title: Customer Architect
listings.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is the Role

We are actively seeking a Customer Architect with an understanding of technology and hands-on experience in key IT domains, notably Observability, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise Search. You should possess a strong technical background, preferably with experience in cloud-based software solutions. 

We value individuals who are passionate about staying at the forefront of technology trends with a growth mindset and excited to learn and implement new technologies.
